result:
Round 413 (PERF-15b-ii-a) is implemented within the 12 granted files. There's no STOP, and all of my checks A1–A5 passed. Nothing was committed or pushed, and no browser was used, since none of the browser rows are mine.

**What changed**
- **Code (9 files):** B's dispatched sketch v4 (sha256 `a7913dec…2201`, the same version B's review covered), applied exactly as written. A reverse-apply check passes and the working diff matches the patch text, so I made no edits to those files. They add:
  - a streamed 4 MiB cap on the peaks body;
  - an abort listener that ends a stalled body read;
  - `fetchPeaks` on the workspace collection, passed through in `ArrangementContext.tsx` (one hunk only);
  - `AudioStem.peaksUrl`, which the purchased adapter keeps only when it is on the same origin as that stem's audio;
  - the new test rows.
- **Docs:** line 4 of docs 263 and 264 now reads `**სტატუსი:** Completed (C round 413 PASS)`. New Georgian doc 265 has the 7 template headings in order, the 15 `MU-413-` lines copied exactly, and cites only test rows that exist.
- `git status` shows 11 modified files and 1 new file (doc 265). Nothing under `app/components` or `app/routes` changed, and no protected file was touched.

**Checks run** (logs in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-413/`)
- **A1:** the start claims match B's planning output exactly, with empty stderr.
- **A2:** `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npx biome check` on the 9 code and test files all return 0. Lint has 205 warnings repo-wide that were already there; none are in my files.
- **A3:** the 24 covering files pass, 436/436. The slowest test took 1,710 ms of its 15,000 ms timeout (11 %); it took 1,911 ms at gate 412.
- **A4:** the end claims match B's sketch output except for the four expected differences: HEAD, the status line count, the three Completed status lines, and the count of 7 "In Progress (stage" docs. The 1,301 frozen files and the protected files are unchanged.
- **A5:** I ran the code-reviewer subagent. It found no Critical, High or Medium issues, only 6 Lows.
  - L1–L5 are in the sketch's code or tests, so I left them for B (details below).
  - L6 says doc 265 shows "Completed" before C has passed. That wording is what the project's status-line rule and the task require, so I kept it.
  - I fixed the two wording findings in doc 265 only. No code changed after the review.

**For B** (in `a-round-413.md`)
- **Reviewer Lows to rule on:**
  - When an abort cuts a read short, the reader returns the partial text; only the caller's abort check makes that safe.
  - No test covers a body exactly one byte over the cap.
  - PK2's bearer-header check can't fail, because the test's own stub adds the header.
  - The same-origin check looks only at the first URL, so a redirect to another host is followed.
  - URLs with no real origin (`data:`, `file:`) count as the same origin.
- **Architecture note:** the reviewer says to keep the capped reader where it is. It should move to its own file only if the audio download ever needs the same cap.
- **Info:** the test id `PS18` also exists, unchanged, in `library-preview-stream.test.tsx`, so mutant logs that say only "PS18" are ambiguous.

**Gaps**
- The purchased-stem path is proved only by unit tests, because the protected purchased route doesn't use this code yet (SRW-21 is deferred).
- The Firefox check can't run here because Playwright Firefox isn't installed.
- C's rows 1–10 (mutants first, then the browser checks on `:5173`) and the gate rows are not claimed. PERF-15 is not marked closed; that happens only when C passes.
